# Tuga Hardware

> Rugged tablets and handhelds built for UK tradespeople. IP65 to IP68 sealed, half the range drop tested to MIL-STD-810H or 810G. Free UK delivery. No VAT to add. 30-day returns and a 12-month warranty on every device. Automatic team discounts: 3% at 2 devices, 5% at 3 to 4, 8% at 5 to 9, 10% at 10 or more.

Small UK retailer of rugged Android and Windows tablets and handhelds for tradespeople. Six devices, three sizes (6, 8 and 10 inch). Android suits app-based work and costs noticeably less; Windows only when desktop software requires it.

## Devices

- [Tuga A6](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-a6): £349. 6 inch handheld, Android 15, IP67, 5050mAh removable, 277g. Barcode scanning, photos, job sheets and sign-off, on a handheld that survives the site.
- [Tuga A8](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-a8): £379. 8 inch tablet, Android 12, IP67, 8000mAh removable. Forms, maps, site photos and quotes, readable in full sun.
- [Tuga A10](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-a10): £449. 10.1 inch tablet, Android 14, IP68, MIL-STD-810H, 8000mAh, 680g. Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets and PDF plans.
- [Tuga WH6](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-wh6): £699. 6.5 inch handheld, Windows 11 IoT, IP65, MIL-STD-810H, 4000mAh, 470g. Legacy Windows software and network drives, in a holster.
- [Tuga W8](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-w8): £629. 8 inch tablet, Windows 11 Pro, IP67, MIL-STD-810G, 5000mAh, 750g. Windows software in the field, with real ports.
- [Tuga W10](https://www.tugahardware.com/products/tuga-w10): £649. 10.1 inch tablet, Windows 11 Pro, IP65, 5000mAh, 1197g. Engineers and surveyors who need Ethernet, HDMI and a full screen.

Scanner versions: Tuga WH6 with Barcode Scanner £779; Tuga W8 with 2D Scanner £699; Tuga W10 with 2D Scanner £729. Each is sold from its base model's page.

## Warranty

- [Warranty and paid plans](https://www.tugahardware.com/warranty): 12 months included on every device. 3-Year Warranty per device: A10 £65, W10 £79, A6 £65, A8 £65, W8 £79, WH6 £89. Total Care for business fleets of 5 or more devices on any model, on a quote.

## Compare

- [Compare two devices head to head](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/): a verdict, every specification side by side and the price gap
- [Tuga A6 vs Tuga A8](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a6-vs-tuga-a8): Only £30 apart and both IP67 with removable batteries: the A8 has the 8 inch 1000 nit screen, a larger 8000mAh battery and VESA mounting; the A6 has a built-in Zebra 2D scan engine, Android 15 and fits a pocket.
- [Tuga A8 vs Tuga A10](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a8-vs-tuga-a10): £70 apart, both 8000mAh: the A8 is far brighter at 1000 nits against 350 and its battery is removable; the A10 has the 10.1 inch 1920 x 1200 screen, 8GB of RAM, Android 14, IP68 and MIL-STD-810H.
- [Tuga WH6 vs Tuga W8](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-wh6-vs-tuga-w8): Same Celeron N5100 and 8GB, £70 apart: the WH6 is a 470g handheld with a removable battery, the W8 an 8 inch tablet with a brighter screen, HDMI and a fingerprint sensor.
- [Tuga W8 vs Tuga W10](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-w8-vs-tuga-w10): £20 apart and both on Windows 11 Pro: the W8 is 447g lighter with IP67, MIL-STD-810G, 4G and GPS built in; the W10 adds a 10.1 inch screen, RJ45 Ethernet, a removable battery and a UHF RFID option.
- [Tuga A6 vs Tuga A10](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a6-vs-tuga-a10): The A6 is £100 cheaper, pocketable and has a built-in barcode scanner and a removable battery; the A10 has the 10.1 inch Full HD screen, more memory, a bigger battery and IP68.
- [Tuga WH6 vs Tuga W10](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-wh6-vs-tuga-w10): £50 apart and the bigger one is cheaper: the W10 is a 10.1 inch Windows 11 Pro tablet with Ethernet and HDMI, the WH6 a 470g Windows 11 handheld with 4G LTE.
- [Tuga A6 vs Tuga WH6](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a6-vs-tuga-wh6): The Android A6 is £350 cheaper, better sealed, lighter and has a Zebra 2D scan engine built in; the Windows WH6 earns its extra cost when you need a desktop program or a network drive in the field.
- [Tuga A8 vs Tuga W8](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a8-vs-tuga-w8): Same 8 inch size and IP67, £250 apart: the A8 has the brighter 1000 nit screen and a larger, removable battery; the W8 adds full Windows 11 Pro, USB-A and HDMI, a fingerprint sensor and MIL-STD-810G.
- [Tuga A10 vs Tuga W10](https://www.tugahardware.com/compare/tuga-a10-vs-tuga-w10): The A10 is £200 cheaper, sharper, 517g lighter and rated IP68 and MIL-STD-810H; the W10 adds Windows 11 Pro, RJ45 Ethernet, HDMI and a removable battery for engineers who plug into panels and plant.
